Question 10
?

Every real 2×2 matrix is not singular.

Some real 2×2 matrices are not singular.

None of the listed.
c
Some real 2×2 matrices are singular.
d
Every real 2×2 matrix is not singular.

Every real 2×2 matrix is singular.
